title: Enchanting Horizons
description: Quality vanilla+ modpack with farmer's delight
body:
- ⚔️ Improved progression
- ✨ Сomplete enchantment rebalance 
- 🌳 Vanilla biome improvements and new ones added 
- 🔥🌌 New nether and ender content 
- 🌾 Farmer's delight with addons 
- 🌈🔊 Lots of visual, sound and atmosphere improvements 
- 🏰👹 New structures and bosses 
- 🎶 New music 
- 🎨⛸️🛗 Various pleasant additions such as custom paintings, skates and elevators 
- ⚡ Good performance
- 🔄 Backports of new updates
- 🍃 All in vanilla style
